### Meet Othman Laraki, the CEO behind Color

Cancer is changing, and organizations are now on the front line of one of the most complex and
costly healthcare challenges. In this video, Color CEO Othman Laraki explains how Color’s Virtual
Cancer Clinic delivers oncologist-led care across the cancer journey to improve outcomes, expand
access, and reduce costs.

Watch Video
[Web link: Color's Virtual Cancer Clinic]

# **A new model** for cancer care

Where traditional programs fall short, Color delivers what is needed. By shifting focus to direct
clinical care, employers can go beyond offering simple navigation to impact outcomes and costs.
Color partners with local providers to clinically manage all patients through our oncologist-led
care team that stays connected with your members from detection and diagnosis, to delivering ongoing
[Expert Medical Opinion][30] and clinical oversight through treatment, survivorship, and supporting
back to work.

Our Virtual Cancer Clinic is a national, virtual cancer center of excellence, built to expand access
to oncology expertise at scale. [Color is ASCO Certified by the American Society of Clinical
Oncology][31], the leading professional organization for cancer physicians, meeting the same
rigorous quality and safety standards as top cancer centers and independently validating a more
accessible, AI and technology-enabled model of cancer care.

[ Explore the Virtual Cancer Clinic ][32]

### Color across the cancer journey

### Prevention, Early Detection, and Diagnosis

Cancer is most treatable and least costly when caught early. Color identifies risk, gets people
screened, and moves quickly on 100% of abnormal results to maximize care.

[Early Detection]

### Planning and Active Treatment

Treatment decisions are high stakes. Color’s oncologist-led clinical team reviews each diagnosis and
treatment plan, works directly with treating providers, and manages symptoms to keep care on track.

[Active Treatment]

### Survivorship Care and Return to Work

Cancer care does not end with treatment. Color’s survivorship oncologists monitor recurrence risk,
support long-term health, and help people return to health, life, and work.

[Survivorship]

# Welcome to Genetic Technologies, Inc. Forensic DNA Testing, Forensic Consulting & Expert Testing

Genetic Technologies, Inc., is an independent, full service DNA forensic science company focusing
primarily on the testing and evaluation of forensic evidence as it relates to human identification.

## Forensic DNA Testing

DNA analysis / forensic biology testing are scientific and therefore unbiased procedures which
provide useful evidence for the prosecution and / or defense in criminal investigations.

[Learn more >][32]

## Forensic Consulting and Expert Testimony

DNA analysis is now commonly considered as admissible evidence in court proceedings. Today, juries
expect DNA evidence to be presented during trial when a sexual assault or murder is involved.

[Learn more >][33]

## Immigration DNA Testing

Our clients can choose from a full range of detailed, thorough and affordable forensic DNA testing
and consulting services.

As part of our consulting services, we painstakingly review the entire case file to include all
items stemming from the original agency’s findings.

[Learn more >][34]

## eDNA Software

eDNA is software developed by Genetic Technologies, Inc. which is used by many facilities in the
Human Identification Industry. eDNA along with eSolve DNA Indexing System provides the forensic
biology laboratory a robust and turnkey Laboratory Information Management System designed to
facilitate every aspect of processing evidence from accessioning to final disposition. Since the
year 2000 more than a million dollars of coding has been performed building and enhancing eDNA. It
is truly the most intuitive yet comprehensive tool for the Forensic biology laboratory.

[Learn more >][35]

# Welcome to Genetic Technologies, Inc. Forensic DNA Testing, Forensic Consulting & Expert Testing

Genetic Technologies, Inc., is an independent, full service DNA forensic science company focusing
primarily on the testing and evaluation of forensic evidence as it relates to human identification.

## Forensic DNA Testing

DNA analysis / forensic biology testing are scientific and therefore unbiased procedures which
provide useful evidence for the prosecution and / or defense in criminal investigations.

[Learn more >][32]

## Forensic Consulting and Expert Testimony

DNA analysis is now commonly considered as admissible evidence in court proceedings. Today, juries
expect DNA evidence to be presented during trial when a sexual assault or murder is involved.

[Learn more >][33]

## Immigration DNA Testing

Our clients can choose from a full range of detailed, thorough and affordable forensic DNA testing
and consulting services.

As part of our consulting services, we painstakingly review the entire case file to include all
items stemming from the original agency’s findings.

[Learn more >][34]

## eDNA Software

eDNA is software developed by Genetic Technologies, Inc. which is used by many facilities in the
Human Identification Industry. eDNA along with eSolve DNA Indexing System provides the forensic
biology laboratory a robust and turnkey Laboratory Information Management System designed to
facilitate every aspect of processing evidence from accessioning to final disposition. Since the
year 2000 more than a million dollars of coding has been performed building and enhancing eDNA. It
is truly the most intuitive yet comprehensive tool for the Forensic biology laboratory.

[Learn more >][35]

## Moving Health Forward Together

At Bionano, we strive to elevate health and wellness for all people through customer-centered
innovations that transform the way the world sees the genome.

##### THE VARIATION PROBLEM

### Reframing Our View

The inability to resolve the continuum of genomic variation—from single nucleotide variants (SNVs)
to structural variants (SVs) up to chromosome-arm scale—is holding us back from comprehensive
disease identification and treatment.

Tools such as karyotyping, FISH and chromosomal microarray (CMA) lack the digital resolution and
efficiency to resolve SVs at scale. Next-generation sequencing (NGS) struggles with larger
structural variants and highly repetitive regions of the genome.

Bionano optical genome mapping (OGM) solutions address this critical gap.

Back
Next

##### PIONEERING INNOVATIONS FOR PROGRESS

### Pioneering Innovations for Progress

Bionano OGM solutions provide the essential tools clinicians and researchers need to reveal
actionable insights from all classes of genomic variation.
* Bionano OGM Mapping Systems—Provide the data other tools miss with digital precision in a rapid,
  highly automated workflow from sample preparation through primary data analysis.
* Bionano Analysis Software—Brings OGM data together with NGS, CMA and other data types in one view
  for truly comprehensive interpretation and analysis of variant data.

Our solutions are backed by a support team dedicated to empowering you to move forward.

Back
Next

##### TRANSFORMATIONAL IMPACT

### Reveal Variation That Matters

OGM users worldwide are making breakthroughs across a wide range of disease states. Over 500
publications cite OGM solutions, and that number is quickly climbing.

Our customers’ discoveries in cancer and genetic disease reveal the variations responsible for
deleterious effects as well as new druggable targets hidden from view until now.

Together, we are moving health and hope forward for patients and their families forward.

Back
Next

##### MEET THE NEEDS

### Focus Areas and Applications

Our OGM systems, software solutions and uncompromising support allow you to reveal more genomic
variation that matters across a variety of applications in clinical care, research and therapeutics.

#### Oncology

Solve the complex biology of hematological malignancies and solid tumors by revealing structural
variants traditional methods miss and create new opportunities for personalized care.

[Learn More][60]

#### Genetic Disease

See chromosomal aberrations with digital clarity and deliver new answers for reproductive health
issues, neurodevelopmental delay and rare disease.

[Learn More][61]

#### Cell Bioprocessing

Enhance your quality control and ensure the genomic integrity and stability of cell lines for
producer cell lines, research cell lines and cell therapy applications.

[Learn More][62]

#### Cytogenomics

Transform your laboratory workflow and detect all classes of chromosomal aberrations in cancer and
genetic disease cases with digital precision.

[Learn More][63]

# Welcome to Genetic Technologies, Inc. Forensic DNA Testing, Forensic Consulting & Expert Testing

Genetic Technologies, Inc., is an independent, full service DNA forensic science company focusing
primarily on the testing and evaluation of forensic evidence as it relates to human identification.

## Forensic DNA Testing

DNA analysis / forensic biology testing are scientific and therefore unbiased procedures which
provide useful evidence for the prosecution and / or defense in criminal investigations.

[Learn more >][32]

## Forensic Consulting and Expert Testimony

DNA analysis is now commonly considered as admissible evidence in court proceedings. Today, juries
expect DNA evidence to be presented during trial when a sexual assault or murder is involved.

[Learn more >][33]

## Immigration DNA Testing

Our clients can choose from a full range of detailed, thorough and affordable forensic DNA testing
and consulting services.

As part of our consulting services, we painstakingly review the entire case file to include all
items stemming from the original agency’s findings.

[Learn more >][34]

## eDNA Software

eDNA is software developed by Genetic Technologies, Inc. which is used by many facilities in the
Human Identification Industry. eDNA along with eSolve DNA Indexing System provides the forensic
biology laboratory a robust and turnkey Laboratory Information Management System designed to
facilitate every aspect of processing evidence from accessioning to final disposition. Since the
year 2000 more than a million dollars of coding has been performed building and enhancing eDNA. It
is truly the most intuitive yet comprehensive tool for the Forensic biology laboratory.

[Learn more >][35]

  service centers, we're working to make innovative genetic testing more accessible. Our combined
  industry leadership will continue to advance the field of genetics while improving patient care
  and access. [Learn more][3]
* [{{showUpText}}]
  How are Invitae’s genetic tests different from other genetic tests?
  
  Invitae’s broad test offerings inform every stage of life for patients and their families,
  providing a single, reliable source for genetic testing. Flexible billing options and built-in
  support enable more clinicians and patients to make confident health decisions based on results.
  Explore tests in [Invitae’s test catalog][4].
* [{{showUpText}}]
  Are genetic counseling services available to all patients undergoing Invitae testing?
  
  A genetic counseling session is available to answer questions about genetic testing and results.
  This is included at no additional cost to patients located in the US, US territories, and Canada
  who have ordered a currently offered Invitae genetic test. Learn more on [this genetic counseling
  page][5].
* [{{showUpText}}]
  Who can I contact today?
  
  To speak directly with client services, email [clientservices@invitae.com][6] at any time or call
  [800-436-3037][7] Monday through Friday, 5:00 am to 5:00 pm Pacific time. Visit our [contact
  page][8] to find more information.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

## Diagnostic Genomic Services

Avigena provides comprehensive diagnostic services for genetic or hereditary conditions coupled with
genetic counseling and e-consults.

Avigena provides comprehensive genomic risk assessments for healthy individuals, encompassing
carrier testing, neonatal screening, adult screening for known monogenic disorders, as well as exome
and genome screening.

## Consumer Genomics

The avigena platform provides additional insights from genomic information that engage consumers
such as ancestry and trait reports and wellness reports.

## Research and Development

medicine and improve public health.

Provide genetic counseling and health coaching to individuals. Provide clinical decision support
tools and e-consults to physicians.

Areas of interest

## How researchers use our products

Our products power breakthroughs across diverse fields, from cancer research and immunology to
neuroscience and developmental biology, enabling scientists to see biology at unprecedented
resolution.
Pharma

### Stacking the odds for greater drug development success

Drug development is one of science’s toughest gambles, with nearly 90% of candidates failing to pass
trials. Our technologies reveal how diseases develop and respond to treatment, empowering the
advancement of high-impact therapies with confidence.

[Discover how single cell is advancing cell therapy for melanoma][16]
Oncology

### Leaving cancer with nowhere to hide

Tumors adapt, resist, and hide from treatment with clever biological tricks. By illuminating these
hidden strategies, our technologies give researchers the clarity to outsmart cancer with a new
generation of therapies.

[See how spatial is reshaping what we know about tumor response][17]
Immunology

### Turning chaos into breakthrough therapies

The immune system shapes our health in powerful ways, good and bad. Our tools uncover how immune
cells fine-tune defense responses and why, in some cases, they misfire. These discoveries will lead
to treatments that help us control our immune system so it works for us, not against us.

[Read how Allen Institute studied over 16 million single immune cells][18]
AI cell models

### Strong AI models start with strong data

From billions of cells to massive tissue collections, accurate AI cell models demand more than just
data. They require the best data. Our technologies deliver the quality needed to build trustworthy
virtual cells that accelerate discovery and drug development.

[Learn how 10x Genomics unites AI and biology][19]

### Our products empower impactful science

With tens of thousands of publications using our products, join the community of scientists
advancing their research with the aid of 10x Genomics.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."

to make their calls?

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Your Body Holds the Map

## **We Help You Read It**

The Genomic Kitchen is where science meets soul. Where the language of your DNA becomes a guide for
nourishing your health, restoring your vitality, and living with intention.

We translate complex genetics into simple, actionable insight, helping you align your daily choices
with what your body truly needs.

## **Who You Are Is Exactly Why You’re Here**

You may be here because your body feels different than it used to. Or because you’re exploring what
longevity and vitality could look like for you.
Maybe you’re chasing answers to small but persistent symptoms.
Feeling a pull to understand your biology more deeply.
Sensing it’s time to take your health into your own hands.

You might even be here out of pure curiosity.

A quiet knowing that there’s more to learn, more to live, more to become.

**Wherever you stand today, you’re in the right place.**

This is your starting point. Where clarity begins.

## **How Our Work is Organized**

**The Genomic Kitchen is the umbrella for everything you see here.**
Founded by Amanda Archibald, RD, it’s where genomic science is translated into real life — through
food, education, and lived experience.

Within The Genomic Kitchen lives **Genomic Living** — a collaborative ecosystem where **personalized
DNA insights serve as the foundation** for how people eat, move, and live.

Genomic Living is built in partnership with trusted experts, including co-founder, Whole Living
Nutritionist **Shannon Le Mintier,** and Human Symmetry specialist **Darryl Frerk**

# Your Body Holds the Map

## **We Help You Read It**

The Genomic Kitchen is where science meets soul. Where the language of your DNA becomes a guide for
nourishing your health, restoring your vitality, and living with intention.

We translate complex genetics into simple, actionable insight, helping you align your daily choices
with what your body truly needs.

## **Who You Are Is Exactly Why You’re Here**

You may be here because your body feels different than it used to. Or because you’re exploring what
longevity and vitality could look like for you.
Maybe you’re chasing answers to small but persistent symptoms.
Feeling a pull to understand your biology more deeply.
Sensing it’s time to take your health into your own hands.

You might even be here out of pure curiosity.

A quiet knowing that there’s more to learn, more to live, more to become.

**Wherever you stand today, you’re in the right place.**

This is your starting point. Where clarity begins.

## **How Our Work is Organized**

**The Genomic Kitchen is the umbrella for everything you see here.**
Founded by Amanda Archibald, RD, it’s where genomic science is translated into real life — through
food, education, and lived experience.

Within The Genomic Kitchen lives **Genomic Living** — a collaborative ecosystem where **personalized
DNA insights serve as the foundation** for how people eat, move, and live.

Genomic Living is built in partnership with trusted experts, including co-founder, Whole Living
Nutritionist **Shannon Le Mintier,** and Human Symmetry specialist **Darryl Frerk**

## **Choose Your Path**

From here, you can explore the different ways people engage with **The Genomic Kitchen** and
**Genomic Living**, depending on your goals and interests.

## **Our Philosophy**

Everything we do begins with one belief: **your biology carries its own wisdom.**

Your genes reveal patterns.
Your lived experience reveals the rest.

We bring these two truths together. Translating genomics, nutritional biochemistry, movement, and
emotional rhythms into guidance that makes sense in daily life.

Whether you're exploring your own health, supporting others in theirs, or immersing yourself in a
retreat experience, our work connects **science, soul, and real-world strategy** so you can live,
and practice, with clarity.

critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

  The Human Heredity and Health in Africa (H3Africa) Initiative aims to facilitate a contemporary
  research approach to the study of genomics and environmental determinants of common diseases with
  the goal of improving the health of African populations.
  FIND OUT MORE

###### H3Africa empowers African researchers to be competitive in genomic sciences, establishes and
###### nurtures effective collaborations among African researchers on the African continent, and
###### generates unique data that could be used to improve both African and global health.
###### 
###### There is currently a global effort to apply genomic science and associated technologies to
###### further the understanding of health and disease in diverse populations. These efforts work to
###### identify individuals and populations who are at risk for developing specific diseases, and to
###### better understand underlying genetic and environmental contributions to that risk. Given the
###### large amount of genetic diversity on the African continent, there exists an enormous
###### opportunity to utilize such approaches to benefit African populations and to inform global
###### health.
###### 
###### The Human Heredity and Health in Africa (H3Africa) consortium facilitates fundamental
###### research into diseases on the African continent while also developing infrastructure,
###### resources, training, and ethical guidelines to support a sustainable African research
###### enterprise – led by African scientists, for the African people. The initiative consists of 51
###### African projects that include population-based genomic studies of common, non-communicable
###### disorders such as heart and renal disease, as well as communicable diseases such as
###### tuberculosis. These studies are led by African scientists and use genetic, clinical, and
###### epidemiologic methods to identify hereditary and environmental contributions to health and
###### disease. To establish a foundation for African scientists to continue this essential work
###### into the future work, the consortium also supports many crucial capacity building elements,
###### such as: ethical, legal, and social implications research; training and capacity building for
###### bioinformatics; capacity for biobanking; and coordination and networking.

marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

# Enabling Precision Data for Precision Medicine

Sentieon® develops and supplies accelerated bioinformatics secondary analysis tools that process
genomics data with high computing efficiency and exceptional accuracy.

### Award Winning Products

[ FULL AWARD LIST ][23]
* * Microsoft Healthcare Blog - [$0.33 whole genome analysis on Azure spot instances][24]
* * AMD White Paper - [12x cheaper and faster long reads analysis with 4th Gen AMD EPYC][25]
* * ARM HPC Blog - [fully supports AWS Graviton and other ARM CPUs][26]
* * Intel Health Analytics Case Study - [ONT long-reads single-cell rapid analysis][27]
* * Dell Technologies Whitepaper - [Direct comparison with NviParabricks on short and long
    reads][28]

### What We Offer

#### **Sentieon® Sequencer-Agnostic Secondary Analysis** - FASTQ-BAM-VCF-GVCF

CPU (x86 & ARM)-accelerated software for drop-in replacements/improvements for BWA-MEM, STAR,
Minimap2, GATK, Mutect2, and large cohort joint calling. DNAscope pipeline supports both short reads
and long reads from all mainstream sequencing platforms.
* Uncompromising accuracy   
* Fast turnaround: <30 min on 30x WGS   
* Cost efficient 
* Support for all short and long read sequencers

The Sentieon® tools achieve their efficiency and consistency through optimized computing algorithm
design and enterprise-strength software implementation, and achieve high accuracy using the
industry’s most validated mathematical models.

Sentieon® solutions are easily scalable, easily deployable, easily upgradable, software-only
solutions.

## Advanced Bioinformatics Services for Genomic Research

Welcome to **Transgenomics**, your trusted partner in cutting-edge bioinformatics analysis. We
specialize in transforming complex genomic data into actionable insights, empowering researchers to
advance discoveries in molecular biology, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic development.

## Our Services

### Bulk RNA-Seq Analysis

Comprehensive transcriptome profiling for gene expression quantification, differential expression
analysis, and pathway enrichment studies.

**Key Features:**
* Differential gene expression analysis
* Gene Ontology (GO) and pathway enrichment
* Alternative splicing detection
* Fusion gene identification
* Quality control and normalization
* Publication-ready visualizations

### Single-Cell RNA-Seq (scRNA-Seq)

Unlock cellular heterogeneity with single-cell resolution transcriptomics, revealing
cell-type-specific expression patterns and developmental trajectories.

**Key Features:**
* Cell type identification and annotation
* Dimensionality reduction (UMAP, t-SNE)
* Clustering and marker gene detection
* Trajectory inference and pseudotime analysis
* Batch correction and integration
* Cell-cell communication analysis

### Single-Cell ATAC-Seq (scATAC-Seq)

Map chromatin accessibility at single-cell resolution to understand regulatory landscapes and
epigenetic heterogeneity.

**Key Features:**
* Peak calling and chromatin accessibility profiling
* Transcription factor (TF) motif enrichment
* Cell type-specific regulatory element identification
* Integration with scRNA-Seq data
* Pseudotime trajectory analysis
* Regulatory network inference

### CUT&RUN Analysis

High-resolution mapping of protein-DNA interactions with reduced background and enhanced
signal-to-noise ratio.

**Key Features:**
* Peak calling and annotation
* Differential binding analysis
* Motif discovery and enrichment
* Heatmap and profile plot generation
* Integration with gene expression data
* Genome browser track generation

### ChIP-Seq Analysis

Gold-standard chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing for histone modifications, transcription
factor binding, and epigenetic profiling.

**Key Features:**
* Peak calling and quality assessment
* Differential binding site identification
* Motif analysis and TF binding prediction
* Chromatin state segmentation
* Integration with RNA-Seq datasets
* Comparative analysis across conditions

## Example Results: Single-Cell Insights

Our advanced computational pipelines generate publication-ready visualizations that reveal
biological insights at unprecedented resolution.

### Spatial Transcriptomics Analysis

Bridge the gap between cellular resolution and tissue architecture by integrating spatial context
with transcriptomic profiling. Following single-cell RNA-seq analysis, spatial transcriptomics
enables the **spatial mapping** of gene expression patterns, revealing how cellular organization
drives tissue function and disease progression.

**Key Features:**
* **Spot-based technologies** (Visium, Slide-seq) for tissue-wide expression mapping
* **Single-cell resolution platforms** (MERFISH, seqFISH, Xenium) for subcellular spatial precision
* **Deconvolution** of spatial spots using scRNA-seq reference datasets
* Spatial clustering and niche identification
* Ligand-receptor interaction mapping in tissue microenvironments
* Integration with histological imaging and pathology annotations
* Spatially variable gene detection
* Trajectory inference across anatomical regions

By combining the cellular resolution of scRNA-seq with the tissue-contextual resolution of spatial
transcriptomics, we provide comprehensive insights into how gene expression is organized across
complex biological systems—from tumor microenvironments to developing organs.

## Moving Health Forward Together

At Bionano, we strive to elevate health and wellness for all people through customer-centered
innovations that transform the way the world sees the genome.

##### THE VARIATION PROBLEM

### Reframing Our View

The inability to resolve the continuum of genomic variation—from single nucleotide variants (SNVs)
to structural variants (SVs) up to chromosome-arm scale—is holding us back from comprehensive
disease identification and treatment.

Tools such as karyotyping, FISH and chromosomal microarray (CMA) lack the digital resolution and
efficiency to resolve SVs at scale. Next-generation sequencing (NGS) struggles with larger
structural variants and highly repetitive regions of the genome.

Bionano optical genome mapping (OGM) solutions address this critical gap.

Back
Next

##### PIONEERING INNOVATIONS FOR PROGRESS

### Pioneering Innovations for Progress

Bionano OGM solutions provide the essential tools clinicians and researchers need to reveal
actionable insights from all classes of genomic variation.
* Bionano OGM Mapping Systems—Provide the data other tools miss with digital precision in a rapid,
  highly automated workflow from sample preparation through primary data analysis.
* Bionano Analysis Software—Brings OGM data together with NGS, CMA and other data types in one view
  for truly comprehensive interpretation and analysis of variant data.

Our solutions are backed by a support team dedicated to empowering you to move forward.

Back
Next

##### TRANSFORMATIONAL IMPACT

### Reveal Variation That Matters

OGM users worldwide are making breakthroughs across a wide range of disease states. Over 500
publications cite OGM solutions, and that number is quickly climbing.

Our customers’ discoveries in cancer and genetic disease reveal the variations responsible for
deleterious effects as well as new druggable targets hidden from view until now.

Together, we are moving health and hope forward for patients and their families forward.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

From Animal Cell Culture to Plant Tissue Culture and Gene Expression analysis, we offer
comprehensive in vitro research services. Elevate your scientific inquiries and unlock new
possibilities in cellular biology.

Experience cutting-edge analytical capabilities with our state-of-the-art technologies, from Protein
Sequencing to LCMS, GCMS, and MALDI. Our analytical prowess, including HPLC, FTIR, and XRD, empowers
researchers to unveil complex molecular structures and functions with precision.

[Schedule an Appointment][31] [Get Started Free][32]

# High Throughput MD Simulations

From advanced Protein and Steered MD Simulations to specialized Nanoparticle, Zn-Based, and Membrane
Simulations, our services provide comprehensive molecular insights. We also offer fully customized
simulations to cater to your unique research challenges.

[Schedule an Appointment][33] [Get Started Free][34]

# Clinical Genomics & Mutation Profiling

From comprehensive Genome and Transcriptome Sequencing to Exome analysis and SNP identification, we
offer advanced solutions to decode the genetic underpinnings of diseases and identify key molecular
targets for treatment.

# Epitope Based Vaccine Design

Our integrated platform delivers precision in vaccine development, utilizing cutting-edge tools such
as B and T cell epitope mapping, mRNA technology, and advanced molecular simulations. By accurately
identifying and targeting TLRs, we enhance the efficacy of vaccines, ensuring they are both highly
specific and immunologically potent. This tailored approach enables us to address complex diseases,
offering innovative solutions for a healthier future.

[Schedule an Appointment][37] [Get Started Free][38]

we are empowering pharmaceutical companies and research centers with a powerful fusion of
**generative AI** and **wet lab capabilities**. Our proprietary platform, **BioNome.AI**, drives the
rapid design and optimization of novel drug candidates, while our integrated biology and chemistry
labs deliver robust validation and development support.
* **AI-Driven Molecule Design:** We use BioNome.AI to generate and optimize high-potential drug
  candidates using cutting-edge generative AI algorithms.
* **Wet Lab Validation:** Our in-house biology and chemistry labs provide experimental
  proof-of-concept, target validation, assay development, and compound screening.
* **End-to-End R&D Support:** From target identification to preclinical development, we offer fully
  integrated services to accelerate drug discovery pipelines.

From **target discovery** to **preclinical insights**, we offer end-to-end services designed to
reduce timelines, enhance accuracy, and bring innovation to every stage of your R&D journey.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

# Your Body Holds the Map

## **We Help You Read It**

The Genomic Kitchen is where science meets soul. Where the language of your DNA becomes a guide for
nourishing your health, restoring your vitality, and living with intention.

We translate complex genetics into simple, actionable insight, helping you align your daily choices
with what your body truly needs.

## **Who You Are Is Exactly Why You’re Here**

You may be here because your body feels different than it used to. Or because you’re exploring what
longevity and vitality could look like for you.
Maybe you’re chasing answers to small but persistent symptoms.
Feeling a pull to understand your biology more deeply.
Sensing it’s time to take your health into your own hands.

You might even be here out of pure curiosity.

A quiet knowing that there’s more to learn, more to live, more to become.

**Wherever you stand today, you’re in the right place.**

This is your starting point. Where clarity begins.

## **How Our Work is Organized**

**The Genomic Kitchen is the umbrella for everything you see here.**
Founded by Amanda Archibald, RD, it’s where genomic science is translated into real life — through
food, education, and lived experience.

Within The Genomic Kitchen lives **Genomic Living** — a collaborative ecosystem where **personalized
DNA insights serve as the foundation** for how people eat, move, and live.

Genomic Living is built in partnership with trusted experts, including co-founder, Whole Living
Nutritionist **Shannon Le Mintier,** and Human Symmetry specialist **Darryl Frerk**

## **Choose Your Path**

From here, you can explore the different ways people engage with **The Genomic Kitchen** and
**Genomic Living**, depending on your goals and interests.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

  The Human Heredity and Health in Africa (H3Africa) Initiative aims to facilitate a contemporary
  research approach to the study of genomics and environmental determinants of common diseases with
  the goal of improving the health of African populations.
  FIND OUT MORE

###### H3Africa empowers African researchers to be competitive in genomic sciences, establishes and
###### nurtures effective collaborations among African researchers on the African continent, and
###### generates unique data that could be used to improve both African and global health.
###### 
###### There is currently a global effort to apply genomic science and associated technologies to
###### further the understanding of health and disease in diverse populations. These efforts work to
###### identify individuals and populations who are at risk for developing specific diseases, and to
###### better understand underlying genetic and environmental contributions to that risk. Given the
###### large amount of genetic diversity on the African continent, there exists an enormous
###### opportunity to utilize such approaches to benefit African populations and to inform global
###### health.
###### 
###### The Human Heredity and Health in Africa (H3Africa) consortium facilitates fundamental
###### research into diseases on the African continent while also developing infrastructure,
###### resources, training, and ethical guidelines to support a sustainable African research
###### enterprise – led by African scientists, for the African people. The initiative consists of 51
###### African projects that include population-based genomic studies of common, non-communicable
###### disorders such as heart and renal disease, as well as communicable diseases such as
###### tuberculosis. These studies are led by African scientists and use genetic, clinical, and
###### epidemiologic methods to identify hereditary and environmental contributions to health and
###### disease. To establish a foundation for African scientists to continue this essential work
###### into the future work, the consortium also supports many crucial capacity building elements,
###### such as: ethical, legal, and social implications research; training and capacity building for
###### bioinformatics; capacity for biobanking; and coordination and networking.

  The Human Heredity and Health in Africa (H3Africa) Initiative aims to facilitate a contemporary
  research approach to the study of genomics and environmental determinants of common diseases with
  the goal of improving the health of African populations.
  FIND OUT MORE

###### H3Africa empowers African researchers to be competitive in genomic sciences, establishes and
###### nurtures effective collaborations among African researchers on the African continent, and
###### generates unique data that could be used to improve both African and global health.
###### 
###### There is currently a global effort to apply genomic science and associated technologies to
###### further the understanding of health and disease in diverse populations. These efforts work to
###### identify individuals and populations who are at risk for developing specific diseases, and to
###### better understand underlying genetic and environmental contributions to that risk. Given the
###### large amount of genetic diversity on the African continent, there exists an enormous
###### opportunity to utilize such approaches to benefit African populations and to inform global
###### health.
###### 
###### The Human Heredity and Health in Africa (H3Africa) consortium facilitates fundamental
###### research into diseases on the African continent while also developing infrastructure,
###### resources, training, and ethical guidelines to support a sustainable African research
###### enterprise – led by African scientists, for the African people. The initiative consists of 51
###### African projects that include population-based genomic studies of common, non-communicable
###### disorders such as heart and renal disease, as well as communicable diseases such as
###### tuberculosis. These studies are led by African scientists and use genetic, clinical, and
###### epidemiologic methods to identify hereditary and environmental contributions to health and
###### disease. To establish a foundation for African scientists to continue this essential work
###### into the future work, the consortium also supports many crucial capacity building elements,
###### such as: ethical, legal, and social implications research; training and capacity building for
###### bioinformatics; capacity for biobanking; and coordination and networking.

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.

inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

# Enabling Precision Data for Precision Medicine

Sentieon® develops and supplies accelerated bioinformatics secondary analysis tools that process
genomics data with high computing efficiency and exceptional accuracy.

### Award Winning Products

[ FULL AWARD LIST ][23]
* * Microsoft Healthcare Blog - [$0.33 whole genome analysis on Azure spot instances][24]
* * AMD White Paper - [12x cheaper and faster long reads analysis with 4th Gen AMD EPYC][25]
* * ARM HPC Blog - [fully supports AWS Graviton and other ARM CPUs][26]
* * Intel Health Analytics Case Study - [ONT long-reads single-cell rapid analysis][27]
* * Dell Technologies Whitepaper - [Direct comparison with NviParabricks on short and long
    reads][28]

### What We Offer

#### **Sentieon® Sequencer-Agnostic Secondary Analysis** - FASTQ-BAM-VCF-GVCF

CPU (x86 & ARM)-accelerated software for drop-in replacements/improvements for BWA-MEM, STAR,
Minimap2, GATK, Mutect2, and large cohort joint calling. DNAscope pipeline supports both short reads
and long reads from all mainstream sequencing platforms.
* Uncompromising accuracy   
* Fast turnaround: <30 min on 30x WGS   
* Cost efficient 
* Support for all short and long read sequencers

The Sentieon® tools achieve their efficiency and consistency through optimized computing algorithm
design and enterprise-strength software implementation, and achieve high accuracy using the
industry’s most validated mathematical models.

Sentieon® solutions are easily scalable, easily deployable, easily upgradable, software-only
solutions.

Sentieon® develops and supplies accelerated bioinformatics secondary analysis tools that process
genomics data with high computing efficiency and exceptional accuracy.

CPU (x86 & ARM)-accelerated software for drop-in replacements/improvements for BWA-MEM, STAR,
Minimap2, GATK, Mutect2, and large cohort joint calling. DNAscope pipeline supports both short reads
and long reads from all mainstream sequencing platforms.
* Uncompromising accuracy   
* Fast turnaround: <30 min on 30x WGS   
* Cost efficient 
* Support for all short and long read sequencers

The Sentieon® tools achieve their efficiency and consistency through optimized computing algorithm
design and enterprise-strength software implementation, and achieve high accuracy using the
industry’s most validated mathematical models.

solutions.

## Advanced Bioinformatics Services for Genomic Research

Welcome to **Transgenomics**, your trusted partner in cutting-edge bioinformatics analysis. We
specialize in transforming complex genomic data into actionable insights, empowering researchers to
advance discoveries in molecular biology, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic development.

## Our Services

### Bulk RNA-Seq Analysis

Comprehensive transcriptome profiling for gene expression quantification, differential expression
analysis, and pathway enrichment studies.

**Key Features:**
* Differential gene expression analysis
* Gene Ontology (GO) and pathway enrichment
* Alternative splicing detection
* Fusion gene identification
* Quality control and normalization
* Publication-ready visualizations

Unlock cellular heterogeneity with single-cell resolution transcriptomics, revealing
cell-type-specific expression patterns and developmental trajectories.

**Key Features:**
* Cell type identification and annotation
* Dimensionality reduction (UMAP, t-SNE)
* Clustering and marker gene detection
* Trajectory inference and pseudotime analysis
* Batch correction and integration
* Cell-cell communication analysis

### Single-Cell ATAC-Seq (scATAC-Seq)

Map chromatin accessibility at single-cell resolution to understand regulatory landscapes and
epigenetic heterogeneity.

**Key Features:**
* Peak calling and chromatin accessibility profiling
* Transcription factor (TF) motif enrichment
* Cell type-specific regulatory element identification
* Integration with scRNA-Seq data
* Pseudotime trajectory analysis
* Regulatory network inference

### CUT&RUN Analysis

High-resolution mapping of protein-DNA interactions with reduced background and enhanced
signal-to-noise ratio.

**Key Features:**
* Peak calling and annotation
* Differential binding analysis
* Motif discovery and enrichment
* Heatmap and profile plot generation
* Integration with gene expression data
* Genome browser track generation

### ChIP-Seq Analysis

Gold-standard chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing for histone modifications, transcription
factor binding, and epigenetic profiling.

**Key Features:**
* Peak calling and quality assessment
* Differential binding site identification
* Motif analysis and TF binding prediction
* Chromatin state segmentation
* Integration with RNA-Seq datasets
* Comparative analysis across conditions

Bridge the gap between cellular resolution and tissue architecture by integrating spatial context

enables the **spatial mapping** of gene expression patterns, revealing how cellular organization

* Spatial clustering and niche identification
* Ligand-receptor interaction mapping in tissue microenvironments
* Integration with histological imaging and pathology annotations
* Spatially variable gene detection
* Trajectory inference across anatomical regions

By combining the cellular resolution of scRNA-seq with the tissue-contextual resolution of spatial
transcriptomics, we provide comprehensive insights into how gene expression is organized across
complex biological systems—from tumor microenvironments to developing organs.
